provider: OVHcloud AI Endpoints (serverless managed OpenAI-compatible API; part of OVHcloud Public Cloud). No Bielik in catalog (catalog is Llama, Mistral, Qwen, gpt-oss, DeepSeek-distill etc.).
region_dc: Gravelines, France (per task brief) [uncertain: OVH docs read do not state DC per model; EU-hosted per OVH marketing, batch API listed as 'WW (out of US)' availability]
sovereignty_class: EU HQ (Roubaix, FR) + EU DC: full EU corporate sovereignty, no US parent, no direct CLOUD Act exposure. Docs state 'we do not store user data' (zero retention for prompts). Certifications ISO 27001 / SOC 2 at provider level; SecNumCloud/HDS/BSI C5 not verified for AI Endpoints [uncertain].
monthly_cost: Pay-per-token, no fixed monthly fee, so 24/7 cost = usage cost only. Catalog Oct 2026 (USD per 1M tok in/out, from aggregator calcaas.com synced 12 Oct 2026, 19 models) [uncertain: OVH official EUR page not fetched]: Llama 3.1 8B 0.10/0.10; Mistral-7B-v0.3 Tools 0.11/0.11; Mistral-Nemo-2407 Tools 0.14/0.14 (being decommissioned 2026-11-04); gpt-oss-20b Reasoning+Tools 0.05/0.18; Qwen3.5-9B Vision+Reasoning+Tools 0.12/0.18; Mistral-Small-3.2-24B Vision+Tools 0.10/0.31 (decommissioned 2026-11-04); Qwen3 32B 0.08/0.23; gpt-oss-120b Reasoning+Tools 0.09/0.47; Llama-3.3-70B Tools 0.74/0.74; DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B 0.67/0.67; Qwen2.5-Coder-32B 0.87/0.87; Qwen3.6-27B and Qwen3.8-27B Vision+Reasoning+Tools 0.47/3.19; Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 0.71/4.25 (262K ctx). Agent-session cost model [assumption]: 1 session = 30 turns x ~12k input tokens (tool schema 4-8k + history resent, no prompt caching assumed) = 360k in + 15k out. 50 sessions = 18M in + 0.75M out; 100 sessions = 36M in + 1.5M out. 100 sessions cost: gpt-oss-120b ~USD 4 (~EUR 3.6); gpt-oss-20b ~USD 2; Mistral-Nemo ~USD 5; Qwen3.5-9B ~USD 4.6; Llama-3.3-70B ~USD 28 (~EUR 26); Qwen3.6/3.8-27B ~USD 22 (~EUR 20, reasoning tokens bill as output, could double). 50 sessions = roughly half. Batch API -50% (async, not for interactive agent loops). All options are far below the EUR 150 cap (worst realistic ~EUR 30/100 sessions); even 10x heavier usage stays under cap with gpt-oss-120b or 27B. FX USD 1 = EUR 0.92 [uncertain].
billing_granularity: Per token (input and output separately), pay-as-you-go, no commitment, no minimum. Inherently scale-to-zero: no idle cost. Batch mode billed per successful request only, failed/expired not charged.
setup_fee_and_lockin: No setup fee, no commitment. Requires Public Cloud project with payment method (Discovery mode keys cannot use the service). Exit cost zero: OpenAI-compatible, swap base_url.
gen_tps_7b_q4: [uncertain] Not applicable/not published: managed API, no llama.cpp Q4_K_M 7B. OVH does not publish per-model decode t/s in docs read. Bielik cannot be run here.
prefill_tps: [uncertain] Not published by OVH. Shared multi-tenant serving (likely vLLM-class on datacenter GPUs [inference]); no prompt-caching pricing found, so tool-schema prefill is billed every turn at full input rate (cheap at 0.05-0.74 USD/M).
ttft_at_4k: [uncertain] Not published, not measured. Shared serverless endpoint, expect sub-second to ~2 s at 4k prompt on small/medium models [inference]; must be benchmarked.
concurrency_slots: Not slot-based. Rate limit: 400 requests/min per Public Cloud project per model (authenticated); anonymous 2 req/min per IP per model; 429 on excess; higher limits on request to OVH support. 400 RPM is ample for 50-100 agent sessions.
ctx_ram_headroom: Provider-managed, no RAM limit for user. Context per model: 262K (Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3.6/3.8-27B, Qwen3.5-397B), 131K (Llama 3.1 8B, gpt-oss-20b/120b, Mistral-Small 3.2, Llama 3.3 70B), 66K (Mistral-7B/Nemo), 32K (Qwen3 32B, Qwen2.5 Coder, Mixtral). Playground limits output to 1024 tokens; API does not.
availability_status: Available immediately after creating Public Cloud project + API key; no waitlist. Batch API is Beta (free during beta, -50% at GA). Models are retired on schedule: Mistral-Nemo-2407 and Mistral-Small-3.2-24B decommission 2026-11-04; BGE-Multilingual-Gemma2 2027-01-21.
egress_traffic: No traffic fee documented for AI Endpoints API; billing is token-only. Agentic payload size negligible.
hosting_model: Managed API (serverless, OpenAI-compatible chat/completions and completions; also Files/Batches API in beta). No control over chat template or tool-call parser; OVH picks serving stack per model. Cannot bring own model (Bielik) on AI Endpoints; custom models need separate AI Deploy product (GPU-hour billing).
tool_calling_support: Per-model, flagged in catalog. Tools supported: Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, Mistral-Nemo-2407, gpt-oss-20b, gpt-oss-120b, Qwen3.5-9B, Mistral-Small-3.2-24B, Meta-Llama-3.3-70B, Qwen3.6-27B, Qwen3.8-27B, Qwen3.5-397B-A17B (10 models per aggregator). NOT tools: Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen3 32B, Mixtral 8x7B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill, Llama 3.1 70B, Qwen2.5-Coder-32B, Mamba Codestral, Llava, Qwen2.5-VL. Server-side OpenAI function calling [uncertain: parser quality/parallel tool calls/strict JSON not verified per model]. Best agentic picks: gpt-oss-120b (cheapest strong), Qwen3.6/3.8-27B.
spec_decode_support: No. Managed API; cannot attach Bielik DFlash draft model. Spec decode is internal to OVH if used at all.
sla_uptime: Base API 99.8% uptime per OVH batch-page spec table (task brief said 99.5% [uncertain which is current; OVH US AI SLA page read lists 99.5% only for AI Training/Notebooks/Deploy, not Endpoints]). Batch API: no SLA, 24h SLO. Credit-based remedy.
llm_inference_tos: Allowed: LLM inference is the product. Covered by OVHcloud Public Cloud Special Conditions, Appendix 10 (AI Endpoints). Not available for US customers/region per batch page ('WW out of US').
price_stability: Prices differ by source and USD/EUR; no official 6-month history found [uncertain]. Catalog churns: new models (Qwen3.6/3.8, Qwen3.5) added and older ones decommissioned with 3-month notice; reasoning-class 27B priced at USD 3.19/M output, i.e. new models launch pricier. Historical raise risk unverified.
model_lock_in: High for model choice, low for platform. Bielik absent from catalog (not available) and cannot be added; catalog removes models with 3-month notice (email only to billing contact, 3 months after usage; model hidden from catalog during grace, 404 after). Switching between OpenAI-compatible endpoints is trivial, but this is not a way to run Bielik. Substituting Qwen/gpt-oss/Mistral loses Polish-specialised quality [inference].
